title: Check for Contradictions in Equations
summary: Given a 2D array of strings representing equations and an array of real numbers, check for any contradictions.
statement: Given a 2D array of strings representing equations and an array of real numbers, check for any contradictions. Return true if a contradiction exists, otherwise return false. Ensure the absolute difference between any two numbers is less than 10^-5 when comparing them.
constraints: Return true when any equation conflicts with ratios implied by earlier equations.
Compare floating ratios with relative tolerance 1e-5.
hints: Store for each node its parent and multiplicative ratio to that parent.
Path compression must multiply weights so each node’s stored weight becomes its ratio to the root.
For different roots, attach one root with the ratio that makes the new equation true; for equal roots, compare the implied ratio with the assertion.
Weighted union invariants preserve every equation along a component, so an inconsistent same-root ratio is exactly a contradiction.
editorial: Weighted union invariants preserve every equation along a component, so an inconsistent same-root ratio is exactly a contradiction.
